headline: Korea Electric Power Corporation confirmed exposure for 650,487 billing users and notified all 869,761 procurement users while it checks the scope. OSV flagged five malicious npm packages under the @c1-ease scope without identifying any downstream victims.

incidents.what: KEPCO confirmed exposure for 650,487 billing users and issued a separate notice for its electronic procurement system; exact procurement exposure and overlap are unresolved.
Together AI confirmed that an unauthorized party downloaded stored samples of customer prompts after a repository credential was exposed.
Rackspace warned that an intruder logged in with leaked credentials and could access Kubernetes secrets in some customer clusters.
Cyber reported unexpected minting on Solana and a matching outflow from its bridge on Ethereum; Upbit and Bithumb suspended CYBER transfers.
Voi Network reported unauthorized withdrawals from the Aramid bridge and said the Voi blockchain itself was not compromised.
Hyflock claimed it took data from Samsung Group; no independent confirmation was found.

incidents.org: Sri Lanka Department of Motor Traffic
incidents.what: The department said its public website was attacked but its separate appointment service stayed operational.
incidents.scale: Appointments unaffected; data exposure not disclosed

incidents.what: OSV flagged five malicious npm packages under the @c1-ease scope; it did not identify any affected organizations.
Cleverbridge confirmed stored payment-card data was copied; customer notices began November 20, and the number affected remains undisclosed.
incidents.scale: Card numbers and security codes; total unknown

incidents.what: Chainflip confirmed theft from two vaults and offered a recovery bounty; the combined dollar value is a media estimate, and no recovery was reported.
incidents.scale: About $12M estimated across Ethereum and Bitcoin

incidents.what: Further coverage detailed the approximately 11 million personal records Tower Records Japan said were exposed; this is not a count of distinct customers.
Project MONAI shipped version 0.8.6 to fix CVE-2026-133968 after Amazon linked the flaw to a September intrusion at a university.
